captions.detailed: A shift-only perspective correction camera lens assembly. It features a rectangular front optic block that slides horizontally on a prismatic joint relative to a rectangular shift housing frame. A ridged cylindrical locking knob is mounted on the side of the housing via a revolute joint, while the rear consists of a cylindrical barrel terminating in a metallic silver bayonet mount plate.
captions.instruction: Generate a shift-only perspective correction lens. The assembly should feature a rectangular front block that slides laterally on a prismatic joint relative to a main rectangular shift frame, a side-mounted shift lock knob on a revolute joint, and a rear cylindrical barrel ending with a silver bayonet mount plate.
captions.factory: Create a main assembly with three parts: the shift housing frame, the sliding front element block, and the shift lock knob. Model the shift housing frame using a hollow rectangular box structure combined with a cylindrical rear barrel and a metallic bayonet flange. Construct the sliding front block using a rectangular prism with rounded corners and an inset cylindrical lens face. Build the locking knob from a small fluted cylinder. Define a prismatic joint for the lateral sliding motion of the front block, and a revolute joint for the side lock knob.
